Minor fixes and improvements


add an indicator for troops' malus when you deploy troop on battlefield. 

better improvements on troops' sheet details in battle.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1
notes.content:
Changelog Patch 0.1

Improvements:
When you go to map scene, camera follow mode is now set as default camera mode.

Now you can choose to set playable window borderless yes/no.

Now the game use the hardware cursor mode for more perfomance.

Every day/night cycle now  a notification reminds you how many days remains to quest expiration.

Totally rebalancing of equipments and bonus/malus calculation. A New Game start it is advisable.


Bugs:
Fixed overlay bug when King sends new fresh troops.

Fixed a bug where, for some reason, missions would not expire.

Fixed a lot of translation strings.

Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Devlog #8 - New Battles Features
notes.content:
Power indicator of two armies.
 When you have to deploy troops, a small icon will immediately let you know which weapon he is equipped with, and whether it is a Ranged or a Melee.
 ability to speed up combat with x2 or x3.
 GUI improvements.
 obstacles caused by boulders that cause the troops that have to avoid them to get stuck and slow down.
 zoom out at the end of the battle
